title: RA attestation self-test on emulated nRF52840 (cooja-ng)

test.description: Single emulated nRF52840 runs the RA Root-of-Trust flow (measure + sign Evidence + appraise + tamper detection) at boot. No radio needed; the attestation runs in the first process. PASS banner = the codec + os/lib SHA-256 + Monocypher Ed25519 run correctly on ARM.
